limitations: This is a bounded static candidate scan, not a complete proof of secret absence, a security certification or a final commit/push approval.
Arbitrary high-entropy strings, encoded secrets, private prose and capability-bearing synthetic identifiers may not match recognized patterns.
Historical failure/source/test labels remain unchanged; explicit fixtures do not become real-provider passes.
The runtime source reference is context supplied by root; the scan hashes publication files and does not execute or inspect running images.
No model/cluster/runtime/private asset/credential access or external scanning service occurred.
Files changed or added after this exact hash snapshot are outside this review.
method: Filename and file-type checks; no symlink following or credential/database-file content reads.
Byte-pattern checks for private-key PEM, common secret-token shapes, SQLite headers and certificate PEM.
Structured JSON sensitive-field shape and protected Secret metadata checks; no sensitive values exported.
Python AST literal-location review for explicit synthetic fixtures and credential-file/entrypoint references.
Wheel ZIP path/member hashes and in-memory member byte-pattern checks; no package execution.
PNG chunk metadata inspection only; root separately reported visual review of solo19 screenshot pixels.
Exact scanned paths and SHA-256 hashes retained; before/after recheck detects concurrent changes.

publication_review_items.review: Generated UnforgPrivate read-name identifiers, public signer and Secret references require exact approved-synthetic trace review; none is classified as a private key by this scan.
Protected Secret object entries use metadata/digests, not Secret.data/stringData. Retain original inventory identity.

Root stated final main19/chain/restore/IRC reports were not all copied when this audit was assigned. Later additions/replacements require another exact staged comparison; existing dev17 labels must not be relabelled19.
Root will select the exact staged allowlist and compare against task-owned credentials after all final reports exist. This scan does not access those secrets or approve publication.
Metadata is inspected; screenshot visible content is outside this scanner. Root reported solo19 visual review; historical screenshots retain prior provenance.

scope.excluded_content: Ignored artifacts, raw runtime stores, private assets, secret/journal directories and every path outside the repository.
scope.selection: Union of modified tracked, staged and nonignored untracked repository paths; own output excluded.
